children: Techlott received notice that its stock has traded below $0.01 and was granted a 90-day cure to meet OTCQB bid requirements.
OTC Markets notified Techlott that closing bid was below $0.01 for over 30 consecutive days, failing OTCQB eligibility.
Techlott has a 90-calendar-day cure period to achieve a $0.01+ closing bid for 10 consecutive trading days to remain on OTCQB.
If requirement not met by October 26, 2026, the common stock will be removed from the OTCQB Venture Market.
Immediate removal will occur if the closing bid falls below $0.001 for five consecutive trading days, with no cure period.
